Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evident based input.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThis e blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comments box is welcome.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment plan.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis \u003C\/b\u003Eis the case of a 28 year old male, resident of Lingotam farmer by occupation who came to OPD with Chief Complaints of\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFever since 6 days\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECold and Cough since 5 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 6days ago, then he developed developed fever which is sudden is sudden in onset and is intermittent which is aggravated during nights and is relieved in the morning. Fever is associated with chills.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen 5 days ago he developed cough which was sudden in onset and productive.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESputum was yellow in colour without blood.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn the same day he developed cold which was associated with noseblock.He was then admitted in our hospital 3 days ago.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe patient had an accident 10 years ago after which he underwent a liver surgery for it.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThen 5years ago he was diagnosed with Acute Appendicitis when he complained of severe stomach pain over right abdominal area. He underwent Appendectomy for it.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is not a known case of Diabetes mellitus, Hypertension, TB, epilepsy.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESURGICAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient had a history of liver surgery 10 years back and history of Appendectomy 5years ago.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet: Mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite: Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder movements: Regular\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep: Normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo addictions\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo relevant family history\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent, cooperative, he is well oriented to time, place and person.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe is moderately built and nourished.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo Pallor, Icterus, Clubbing, Cyanosis, Lymphadenopathy and Edema\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both;
